title: Netflix will stream the Women’s World Cup draw live in December.
summary: Ahead of streaming the full tournament , which starts in June 2027, Netflix will air the draw on December 11th, though a specific time hasn’t been announced yet. If you buy something from a Verge link, Vox Media may earn a commission.
